alt: What's the one thing this week you're already dreading? Just the word. Nobody else sees your reply. Moodius: the Thursday call.
You drive past somewhere you used to live. Afterwards you mostly feel: A  warmer / B  worse Reply with A or B. Answer tomorrow at 9.

If you said A, so did the research. People asked to write about a nostalgic memory came out feeling more connected to others and surer of who they were. Wildschut et al., J. Personality and Social Psychology, 2006.
Septima Clark or Arthur Ashe? Clark: the teacher behind the civil-rights citizenship schools. Ashe: the champion who used his platform off the court. Tap the poll, or reply with a name.
Before you send it today. Write the message. Read it as the person receiving it. Then decide. Votes from last night still open.
Which emotion visited most this week? One word. Nobody else sees your reply. Reply with one word. Answer tomorrow at 9.
Whatever you named last night had a reason to come. Today, when it shows up, ask what it wants before you argue with it.
What did you forgive today? Big or tiny. The driver counts. Reply with one word. Answer tomorrow at 9.
In 1747 a ship's doctor tested six remedies on twelve sick sailors. Which one worked? A  cider / B  oranges and lemons / C  seawater Reply A, B or C. Answer at 12:00.
Next Friday's forgotten history. Which field? A  medicine / B  astronomy / C  food Reply A, B or C. Most replies wins.
Part 3 of 3 lands at 12:00. A three-step test for how free you are. Guess the steps before you watch.
What did today teach you? One line. It doesn't have to be profound. Reply with one word. Answer tomorrow at 9.
Born enslaved. Banished from Rome. The full Epictetus story, ten slides, at 12:00. Read it slowly.
What will you do differently tomorrow? One sentence. Write it where you'll see it at 7am. Reply with one word. Answer tomorrow at 9.
Your anger costs you more than what caused it. The emperor's ledger, at 12:00. Until then: count the minutes.
Who needs a message from you? Not the reply you owe. The one nobody's expecting. Reply with one word. Answer tomorrow at 9.
